comment: The pace of every fight on screen, in ticks of 60 to a second and in art pixels (D-266, D-829, D-883). The timings of PR-10 keep their values. A strike holds 44 ticks at normal, 66 at slow, and 22 at fast, and the blow, the hit-stop, the flash, and the shake keep their own ticks at each speed, so each one ends inside 22 ticks (D-873). A heavy blow, a hit on a weakness, freezes the picture at the blow and shakes the battle picture from side to side (D-876, D-877, D-880). The reduced level shakes a quarter of the full distance, the off level plays no shake, and the hit-stop plays at each level (D-863).
